'''Dapp Solus''' was a [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] and member of the [[Happy Blasters]]. A native of [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], he stole a ship once he was old enough and started a career as a pirate in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Solus was approached by [[Salem Victory]] for helping in designing and building the ''[[Starcat (light freighter)|Starcat]]''. Solus accepted, and stayed on as [[First Mate/Legends|First Mate]].<ref name="Scout" />
